hypothesis: Local RTP-vs-TMI regression discordance (remanence / vertical-axis block rotation) marks block-bounding faults that amplitude-based magnetic detectors and DEM scarp detectors both miss under alluvial cover.
mechanism: High-pass TMI (band 14) and RTP (band 2) at sigma=3px; Gaussian-weighted (sigma_w=2.5px) local linear regression RTP_hp ~ a*TMI_hp+b gives slope a(x), correlation r(x), residual RMS; discordance breaks are |grad r|, |grad a|, residual RMS ridges and the signed z-difference gradient, with mag_anom(band1)-vs-RTP residual as second pair. 8 label-free channels; composite S_rrd = geometric mean of footprint percentile ranks of (resid_rms, corr_break, slope_break, disc_grad).
named_non_fault_mimic: Unfaulted margins of reversely-magnetized volcanic flow units; GeoDAWN survey-block levelling seams.

experiments.exp1: Build 8 RRD channels label-free; verify RTP/TMI band identities numerically; per-channel leakage canary on seed-20 draw (symmetric AUC>0.90 stops the lane); Phase-1 surface Spearman vs local registry scope (docs/downloads + submissions TIFFs + fetched H33 champion bytes).
experiments.exp2: Seed-20 buffered whole-component hide-and-recover, evaluator gems57-pooled-hide-v2 (alpha 0.2, beta 0.8, 300m triangular). Arms: S_rrd physics, A_rrd HGB(8ch), A_std19 HGB(19 raw bands), A_std19_rrd HGB(27ch, primary), A0_random. Fixed budget 37654 dots, exclusion >2px from visible, min-sep 2.8px via src/gems77/emit77. NO operating-point scan. HGB fixed: max_iter=140, lr=0.09, max_leaf_nodes=31, min_samples_leaf=40, random_state=77.
experiments.exp3: Full-map TIF from preregistered winner rule (highest Exp2 HOLDOUT-DTI among S_rrd/A_rrd/A_std19_rrd; refit on full catalogue if HGB arm wins); shared submission writer (zeros mode, nodata=None); Phase-2 final-dot uniqueness; validator; JSON run card.
